To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the integration of humanist, critical and postmodernist approaches is possible in the construction of adult education theory; (2) the integration of the different approaches is not an obstacle but a resource that enriches theory and reflects the diversity of social agents; and (3) the integration of different approaches does not mean that they have to be equal but that they are complementary and enrich each other.
the integration of the humanistic, postmodern and critical perspectives is possible, and that this integration enriches the AE theory and reflects the diversity of the social actors.
the integration of apparently contradictory conceptions in a theory is possible.
